title: Visiting Research Fellowships
institution: Institute for Advanced Studies in the Humanities (IASH), University of Edinburgh
about: IASH at the University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom invites applications for 2027-28 Visiting Research Fellowships of two to six months, with visits between 1 August 2027 and 31 July 2028. Applications and references close at 17:00 GMT on 26 February 2027.
requirements: References must reach the Institute Director by the deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Researchers" in "Humanities" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Visiting Research Fellowships" (a research proposal-based fellowship) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
